description: This file defines the SecureMediaPermissions class which implements IPermissionProvider to manage permissions related to media folders in OrchardCore, including dynamic permission creation for secure folders and permission retrieval with caching.

classes.name: SecureMediaPermissions
classes.description: Provides permission management for media folders, including dynamic permission creation and caching.

methods.name: GetPermissionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves permissions, utilizing caching and cache expiration tokens.

methods.name: GetDefaultStereotypes
methods.description: Returns default permission stereotypes for different user roles.

methods.name: ConvertToDynamicPermission
methods.description: Converts a static permission to a dynamic permission based on a template.

methods.name: CreateDynamicPermission
methods.description: Creates a dynamic permission for a specific folder based on a template.

methods.name: GetPermissionsInternalAsync
methods.description: Internal method to generate permissions for each media folder, including dynamic permissions.
